description: Na₂VO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-17°. There are two shorter (2.24 Å) and four longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-18°. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and four longer (2.33 Å) Na-O bond lengths. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-16°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°.
